name: Glitch status
what: A sci-fi status line: each letter scrambles through random signs before it locks, glitches jolt it now and then with a colour split, small lines type in, scan lines roll.

learned_from.what: the teal mono status typing in on dark, a small status line

motion: a letter every 1.5 f scrambles 6-9 f then locks; glitches 2 f every ~30 f
